releasePlan.notes: Flag gates the blocking ENTER CALLSIGN overlay in init(). control variation: no login overlay, game proceeds directly to START GAME overlay (pre-PR behavior exactly preserved). v1 variation: login overlay shown after LD SDK initializes; callsign sanitized, persisted to localStorage, displayed in HUD PLAYER field, and used as LD user context key via ldClient.identify(). Evaluation order restructured: await initLaunchDarkly() → evaluate flag → branch on control/v1. Fail-safe default is 'control' (SDK unavailable → no overlay shown). No prerequisites.

releaseIntent._instructions: Human approver: edit freely. action: auto (release on deploy) | hold (do not release yet) | manual (a human runs the release). Structured fields execute; anything else goes in notes (an agent will structure it on the PR for your review). Blank fields = default auto-release on deploy. prerequisites: [{"flagKey": "flag-xyz", "variation": "on"}]. notBefore: YYYY-MM-DD. reference: ticket/doc URL.
